title: Power system
description: One power system a place can sit on: the grid, island system or national mix whose fossil share is for a node to read. One file per system at systems/energy/<id>.yaml; scripts/validate.py checks each against this schema, that the file is named for its id, that every polygon is closed, and that every `sources` and `readings` id exists.

polygon.description: A ring of [lon, lat] points. The first point repeats as the last (validate.py checks that).

source.description: The feed's name as the node knows it, e.g. ree.

geo_limit.description: The feed's own name for the area.

geo_id.description: The feed's own id for the area.

id.description: The system's id, and the name of its file.

name.description: The system as its operator names it.

polygon.description: The area the system serves. Required unless the mix is national.

rings.description: Nested areas inside the system, for a city and a region, each a closed polygon.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Required for a national system, which has no polygon.

mix.description: How the system's generation mix is known.

source.description: The feed the mix is read from.

geo_limit.description: The feed's own name for the area.

geo_id.description: The feed's own id for the area.

fossil_share.description: Fossil share of the country's generation, 0 to 1.

year.description: The year the share is for.

capacity_factors.description: Fuel to capacity factor, used when the mix is estimated.

links.description: Connections to other systems, such as a submarine cable.

name.description: The link as it is known.

rated_mw.description: Rated transfer in MW, or null where no open table states it.

fossil_share.description: Fossil share assumed for what the link brings in.

ring.description: The link sits outside the rings.

source.description: Where the figures on the link were read.

mix_from.description: The feed that gives the mix on the far side.

demand_mw.description: Average demand in MW, or null where no open table states it.

readings.description: The readings in readings.yaml this system serves.

sources.description: Registry entries (pillar/scale/slug) the system's figures come from.

attribution.description: The credit each licence asks for, in its words.

notes.description: Facts about the system and where each figure was read.
